notes.title: Wrath of Loki and Trains VR Bundle!
notes.content:
Great news!
We decided to celebrate the release of TrainsVR on Steam by creating an awesome bundle with additional 20% discount!. Don't hesitate, hop on board today!  ^_^

notes.title: Trains VR is live!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Adventurers![/b]

We're happy to announce that after exploring a fascinating reality of the famed Norse mythology with you, we want to take you into quite a different world. A world filled with one of the most beloved human inventions ever – trains. 

Here it is: Trains VR!
[url=http://pxlme.me/mS82DFzL] YouTube [/url]

In our new game, you can build crazy railways, solve puzzles, ride the train yourself or simply set a few locomotives on two ends of the rail and enjoy the inevitable crash! 

All of this is available from May 1, 2018, for [url=http://pxlme.me/G__9fu7f] Gear VR [/url], [url=http://pxlme.me/QbzJmC1y] Oculus Go [/url], and soon on other VR platforms via Steam too

You can add the game to your wishlist here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/519980/Trains_VR/] Steam Trains VR [/url]

See you in the cab!
The House of Fables Team

notes.title: Update #1 – Delve even deeper into Asgaard!
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers!

We're pleased to announce that Wrath of Loki VR Adventure is now available on Windows Mixed Reality! From now on, MR-enabled system owners will also be able to enjoy the spectacular world of Norse mythology!

To celebrate, we're discounting the game by 30% – grab it while the offer lasts!

Last but not least, we'll soon be releasing TWO BRAND-NEW VR TITLES on Steam. Stay tuned!

Don’t forget to follow us on Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/TheHouseofFables/) as well and leave your comments here – we’re more than eager to hear your impressions of the game’s MR!
